Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

Cross
Writing Instrument Lot - 4 Pieces
Gold and Silver Toned, Vintage
A collection of four vintage Cross writing instruments, representing the classic American craftsmanship of the A.T. Cross Company. These pens feature the iconic slim silhouette and conical tops that have defined the brand's aesthetic for decades. This lot includes two distinct pairs in gold and silver-toned finishes, providing a range of styles for collectors or daily use.
Items Included:
Gold-toned ballpoint pen with vertical linear engine-turned texture and personalized script engraving, housed in a clear display case.
Silver-toned chrome ballpoint pen with a smooth polished finish and signature pocket clip, housed in a clear display case.
Gold-toned ballpoint pen featuring a "Hostess" heart tag, housed in a black presentation box.
Silver-toned chrome ballpoint pen with a sleek, minimalist finish, housed in a black presentation box.
One additional Cross ballpoint pen refill included.
Condition:
The metal bodies of all four pens exhibit signs of use, including visible surface scratches and scuffs, which are more prominent on the chrome finishes. One gold-toned pen features a personalized script engraving. The internal twist mechanisms are intact, though the pens have not been tested for ink flow or writing functionality. The display cases show moderate shelf wear, including surface scuffing and light scratches to the clear plastic components.

description: This lot includes a variety of natural mineral specimens featuring geodes, quartz crystals, and agate nodules. Geodes vary in size with rough tan and brown exteriors; interiors contain quartz or calcite crystals in white, cream, and light brown shades. Several geodes are cut open to display crystal formations, while others remain uncut or partially open. The collection also contains loose quartz crystal points and agate nodule halves exhibiting banded patterns and sand-filled interiors. All specimens are in natural, unpolished condition with visible natural wear consistent with collection.

title: Mixed Lot 6 Collectible Mineral Rock Fossil Specimens 1-2 Inch Display Set
description:
This lot includes six collectible specimens: a polished clear selenite wand, a cabochon stone with yellow mineral deposits (possibly jasper or agate), a fossilized rock with visible marine fossil imprint, a small dark tumbled stone (possibly obsidian or onyx), a rough mineral cluster with crystalline formations, and a small brownish mineral specimen. Sizes range from approximately 1 to 2 inches. All items are in good condition, suitable for collectors, educators, or rock and fossil enthusiasts.

Buy confidently, knowing this is an authentic vintage piece, ideal for gifting or personal enjoyment.

Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. : Lot Of 9 Pcs Tobacciana Smoking Pipe Lighters Ashtray Oliva Box Dr Grabow Parts Used

: Assorted Tobacciana Lot: Pipes, Ashtray, Oliva Box

Description
: This assorted tobacciana lot brings together a unique collection of vintage-inspired smoking memorabilia, offering both functional value and nostalgic appeal. The selection includes two tobacco pipesone with a classic wooden finish and another accented with blue-and-white porcelainperfect for collectors or pipe enthusiasts. A ceramic 'Arizona' ashtray adds a southwestern charm and practical use for pipe or cigar smokers.
Also featured is an Oliva Serie V Melanio wooden cigar box with a sturdy hinged lid, ideal for storing cigars or as a display keepsake. The lot contains a decorative gold and black lighter in the original box, plus two adjustable flame lighters (blue and red) in retail packaging for convenience. Complementing the set is a Dr. Grabow filter pack and a cast iron match holder with ornate detailing, suitable for rustic home decor or use.
A large white oval tray, likely for pipe rests or multipurpose display, rounds out the assortment. All items exhibit visible wear and vintage character, and are offered as shown.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. These specimens are in good, display-ready condition, suitable for collectors or those interested in natural minerals.

This natural agate geode features exquisite concentric banding in shades of steel blue, soft grey, and translucent white. Formed within volcanic rock cavities, this specimen showcases the transition from cryptocrystalline chalcedony to macrocrystalline quartz, culminating in a delicate druzy-lined central aperture. The contrast between the polished face and the raw, unrefined exterior highlights the unique geological processes that create these treasures.

description: This listing includes three rough, unpolished mineral or crystal specimens accompanied by a cloth drawstring pouch labeled 'STANCO'. The set contains two clear to white crystals, likely quartz or calcite, and one darker specimen, possibly smoky quartz or another dark mineral. The crystals have natural, irregular shapes with surface inclusions and some dirt, indicating they are raw and unprocessed. The pouch is suitable for storing or displaying the specimens. These minerals are intended for collectors, hobbyists, or educational use.
